_doc: Real-click flows shared by rm-check.cjs (terminal states under prefers-reduced-motion), flow-compare.cjs (normal-speed frame rows) and capture.cjs ({"flow":"<name>"}). Steps: click (selector; several comma-separated alternatives allowed; {last:true} takes the last visible match, {js:true} a synthetic click) · wait · scrollEnd (scroll a container to its end) · input ({sel,value}) · key ({key,focus,times}) · expectSel (a visible element must exist) · expect (js with root/inst/sr returning true) · eval. Selectors follow my-r2/spec/contract.md §6; expectations read the shared data (my-r2/src/core/ju-data.js) through inst.state.data.

read-confirm.title: 阅读确认 → 成局出票

steps.expect: var it = inst.state.data.joined.filter(function (x) { return x.eventId === 'brunch'; })[0]; return !!it && it.stage !== 'invited';
steps.name: brunch no longer invited

tear-contact-copy.title: 撕票 → 联系 → 复制 → 已加微信

steps.expect: var it = inst.state.data.joined.filter(function (x) { return x.eventId === 'run3k'; })[0]; return !!(it && it.ticket && it.ticket.torn);

steps.expect: var it = inst.state.data.joined.filter(function (x) { return x.eventId === 'run3k'; })[0]; return !!(it && (it.contactAdded || it.stage === 'going'));

steps.expect: var it = inst.state.data.joined.filter(function (x) { return x.eventId === 'livehouse'; })[0]; return !!(it && ((it.reschedule && it.reschedule.answered === 'accepted') || it.stage !== 'reschedule'));

steps.expect: var it = inst.state.data.joined.filter(function (x) { return x.eventId === 'livehouse'; })[0]; return !!(it && ((it.reschedule && it.reschedule.answered === 'declined') || it.stage === 'declined'));

steps.expect: var it = inst.state.data.joined.filter(function (x) { return x.eventId === 'vintage'; })[0]; return !!(it && it.stage !== 'waitlist');
steps.name: vintage left the queue

review-approve-reject.title: 审核通过 / 谢绝 → 计数与席位

steps.eval: window.__juPendingBefore = inst.state.data.hosted.filter(function (x) { return x.eventId === 'bar'; })[0].applications.filter(function (a) { return a.status === 'pending'; }).length;

steps.expect: var it = inst.state.data.hosted.filter(function (x) { return x.eventId === 'bar'; })[0]; var n = it.applications.filter(function (a) { return a.status === 'pending'; }).length; return n <= window.__juPendingBefore - 2 || (window.__juPendingBefore < 2 && n === 0);
steps.name: two applications handled
